Calendar interoperability uses these unmodified open-source JavaScript libraries:

ical.js 2.2.1
Purpose: iCalendar parsing, time-zone components, event and recurrence exceptions.
Project: https://github.com/kewisch/ical.js
License: Mozilla Public License 2.0; full text: ical.js-MPL-2.0.txt

rrule 2.8.1
Purpose: bounded, date-range recurrence expansion for imported calendar events.
Project: https://github.com/jakubroztocil/rrule
License: BSD 3-Clause; full text: rrule-BSD-3-Clause.txt
